listing.name: Gravity Rush 2 — Gravity Rush for Windows (Prathewsh)
listing.summary: Research project. Experimental research project: neither title has verified Windows gameplay, and a complete native build is not verified. The recorded CMake attempt stopped for missing Vulkan headers/libraries in the macOS development environment; this does not prove every native host build fails. Utility/Python checks do not verify in-game rendering. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own decrypted PS4 Gravity Rush 2 dump CUSA00547/CUSA03694/CUSA04934/CUSA04943, containing eboot.bin and sce_sys/param.sfo. Bundled executable/FPS patches target update01.11; other versions run without those patches, not with verified gameplay compatibility. Optional audio module libSceNgs2.sprx comes from the owner console. Do not accept Remastered CUSA01113/CUSA01130 as this game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Upstream documents Windows source packaging and a launcher preparing the selected owned decrypted dump. A successful complete native build/player route is not verified by the retained primary. Its recorded Mac development configuration lacked Vulkan headers/libraries; do not generalize that environment failure to all native hosts or assert a verified release package.
